approach_rationale: User goal: own top-1-4 on lower-pop, ultra-low-difficulty intent long-tails to add ~30 dl/month, instead of fighting saturated head terms. Couples niche validated via Astro: app already ranks #4 'controle de gastos do casal' (pop5 diff5) with ZERO targeting; #7-15 across the casal cluster. Big finance apps (Mobills/Organizze) ignore it. App supports it (login+cloud sync = couple shares one account). Concentrate 'casal' in name (7x) + subtitle (3x) to capture the whole cluster; keywords add 'compartilhados' + distinct long-tail stems. Also unblocks 'financas pessoais' (pop59, was rank 1000) via subtitle 3x.

hypothesis.if_we_change: name 'Meus Gastos: Contas e Despesas' -> 'Meus Gastos: Casal e Despesas' (29); subtitle 'Controle financeiro e receitas' -> 'Financas do casal e pessoais' (28); keywords -> 'compartilhados,contas,minhas,economias,planilha,orcamento,diario,cartao,dividas,fatura,mensais' (94).
hypothesis.then_we_expect: Top-1-4 on couples cluster (controle de gastos do casal, gastos do casal, despesas do casal, gastos casal, financas do casal, contas do casal, app de gastos casal) + rank gastos/despesas compartilhados; financas pessoais (pop59) enters top-50 from 1000; +20-30 dl/month BR.
hypothesis.because: diff 5-15 on casal cluster = near-zero competition; name carries 7x weight; app already #4-15 unoptimized. Low pop (5) per term but ~8 terms aggregate + clear purchase intent (couple seeking shared expense app).
